title: Best Private Luxury Sunset Boat Tour in New York City - 2 Hour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
A minimum of two people per booking is required
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the breathtaking beauty of New York City as the sun sets behind the Statue of Liberty and reflects off of the city skyline on this magical 2-hour sunset cruise around lower Manhattan! Get an unobstructed view of the Manhattan skyline, Freedom Tower, Empire State Building and an up-close and personal view of the Statue of Liberty! Passengers are free to bring any food or drinks onboard the boat.
